events.title: A Tiny Adventure on Your Taskbar — Meet the Demo First
events.summary: Hello Tamers, this is Kniv Studio.Traymon World is taking part in this Steam Next Fest! You can play the demo freely throughout the festival.About Traymon WorldTraymon World is an idle RPG where tiny monsters explore and battle on their own, right on your taskbar in the corner of your screen. events.title: Traymon World Demo Out Now!
events.summary: Hello, Tamers!The Traymon World demo is now live.✨ What's in the demo12 small, adorable monsters you can raise in the corner of your desktopCharms with a variety of options to power up your monstersChapter 1 fields, accompanied by relaxing BGMWe'll keep adding new features and monsters to the demo.Follow our official Discord Server for update news and future demo announcements.— KNIV Studio
